name: Dark
notes: The same three surfaces as Indigo and the same order to them, darkest to
lightest: the frame, the sidebar beside it, and the content it insets. Only
the content has crossed over - it is dark now, and contentIsDark() turns the
chat nicknames over to their light set by itself.
The page is a shade darker than the cards on it rather than lighter, which is
how Indigo has it too: contentAlt recedes and content sits on top of it. That
reads as depth in either direction, and it means every rule written for one
The accent is light here where Indigo's is dark, because it is a fill for the
one action a panel is for and has to carry accentText on top of it. So the
pair swaps rather than the roles: light fill, dark ink, both ways round.
The notice band goes the other way from Indigo's, which is a wash lighter
than white: here it is lighter than the content it sits on, because that is
the direction a tint has to go to be seen on a dark page.
The warning band keeps its amber but swaps which end of it is the surface and
which is the ink, for the same reason the accent pair does: the tint has to sit
darker than a dark page to read as a band, and the ink on it lighter.
The radii are Indigo's and are not restated - anything this file leaves out
is inherited from the theme it extends.
